title: Enter to send
text: Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line, or switch to Ctrl/Cmd+Enter; IME composition never sends by accident.

title: Grows with the text
text: The field grows from one row up to maxRows, then scrolls, without layout jumps.

title: Attachments
text: Attach by button, paste, or drop, with type, size, and count limits, removable chips, and announcements.

title: Send becomes Stop
text: While a reply streams, the Send button turns into Stop and the field stays editable for the next message.

title: Commands and mentions
text: Trigger characters such as / and @ open a keyboard-driven suggestions list from your own data.

title: A real form control
text: Label, help text, validation, a character or token counter hook, and Form integration like every other field.
